segments.name: exploration and evaluation of mineral properties
segments.description: Explores and evaluates mineral properties, principally uranium projects in Colombia and Argentina, with no revenue.
segments.evidence: The Company operates in one reportable segment which is the exploration and evaluation of mineral properties.

revenueModel.text: The company has no revenue, so no customers pay it for any product or service.
